'''The Scourge''' was a gang of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] who operated in the outlying unpoliced areas of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a band of Scourge pirates operated out of the frozen planet [[Orto Norwe]] in the Mid-Rim. The leader of the group, a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] named [[Nukss]], and all but one of his men were slain by the [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrothers]] [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] and [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]].<ref name="TCWTSH" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the organization was led by [[Chalmer Trillili]]. The gang employed a fleet of six stolen [[GAT-12 Skipray Blastboat|Skipray Blastboats]], a modified [[Freighter/Legends|space barge]], a [[Gravity well/Legends|gravity well]]-equipped container [[Starship/Legends|ship]] called the [[Impasse]], and Chalmer's own [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]]. The gang was secretly hired by [[Imperial Mining, Ltd.]] to guard the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alluuvia]].<ref name="Operation: Elrood (book)" />
